author: neal_illustrator
title: Looking for comic and animation team artists
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Kirim CV & Portofolio ke: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subjek: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Dibuka sampai semua posisi terisi.

author: attenboroughac
title: Open call: floral mural painter for exhibition
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Jemisha Maadhavji is looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Commission fee £750. Materials will be provided. Duration 3 days: 28th September 2026 to 30th September 2026. Location Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Send bio, portfolio to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21st September 2026.

author: wscf.europe
title: Call for illustrator — MOZAIK 44
content: CALL FOR ILLUSTRATOR — MOZAIK 44. We’re looking for an illustrator to bring the next edition of MOZAIK to life. Send us: CV, motivation letter & portfolio. Deadline: 30 September 2026. Email: wscf@wscf-europe.org
